title: The message field
purpose: The kit's message field alone: the Composer inside PiChat (composerLayout 'pill', attach button, file chips, slash list, tap-to-record microphone) on a neutral page over a fake controller. The thread above it only shows what was sent. It is the field the bar layout is made of; read-only is the host's own note passed as renderComposer, as AppShell does.

fixture.install: npx shadcn@4.23.0 add pi-chat pi-chat-markdown pi-chat-slash pi-chat-voice
fixture.usage: <PiChat controller={controller} locale="fr" header={false} showHistory={false} emptyLayout="docked" composerLayout="pill" composerBarActions="attach" composerFileChips slash={slash} attachments={attachments} voiceMessage={{ transcribe, ...voiceMessagePlugin }} voiceReplacesSend />

notes: While a recording runs its timer changes the page every second: the steps that happen during a recording settle for 100 ms only (settleMax). The field keeps its place and its height when the person types, attaches or dictates; every control of the field is at least 44 px on a phone; the placeholder is read in full; French words stay as they are.

steps.text: Peux-tu relancer le client Maison Delorme pour la facture de janvier ?

steps.expect: The field is focused and the keyboard can open.

steps.say: Type « Rapproche le relevé de janvier »
steps.expect: The text shows in the field and Send is ready.
The field empties at once, my message is in the thread and the stop button shows.
The reply arrives and the field is ready for another message.
A list of actions opens above the field.
The list closes and the action's words are in the field, nothing is sent yet.

steps.say: Tap the paperclip and pick a file
steps.expect: The file shows as a chip in the field, with its name.

steps.say: Type a line about the file

steps.expect: The message goes with the file and the chip leaves the field.
The field turns into a recording row with a timer and a cancel button.

steps.say: Tap again to stop and send
steps.expect: The recording ends and the message appears in the thread, transcribed.
